description: This file defines the RestApi class for handling RESTful API requests in the TestLink testing management system. It includes methods for managing test projects, test plans, test cases, test suites, builds, keywords, platforms, and test case executions, as well as authentication and utility functions.

classes.name: RestApi
classes.description: Main class implementing REST API endpoints for TestLink, managing authentication, project/test plan/test case operations, build management, and execution recording.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates incoming requests based on API key provided in headers.

methods.name: setContentTypeJSON
methods.description: Sets response header Content-Type to application/json.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns a simple message indicating the caller's identity.

methods.name: testprojects
methods.description: Retrieves accessible test projects for the current user.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Internal method to fetch projects; supports filtering by ID or name prefix.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Retrieves latest versions of test cases associated with a project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves test plans associated with a project.

methods.name: getPlanBuilds
methods.description: Retrieves builds associated with a test plan.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build under a test plan after permission checks.

methods.name: updateBuild
methods.description: Updates existing build details with permission validation.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates a test plan record.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Records execution of a test case, performing several environment checks and validation.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite.

methods.name: addPlatformsToTestPlan
methods.description: Links platforms to a test plan after validation.

methods.name: buildTestCaseObj
methods.description: Builds internal test case object from API input, resolving test project and suite references.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Validates environment info for executing a test case, including test plan, build, platform, and test case correctness.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Validates related entities such as test project and suite exist and are properly linked.

methods.name: userHasRight
methods.description: Checks user permission rights for specific actions related to test project and plan.

methods.name: getStdOp
methods.description: Returns standard 'ok' response structure.

methods.name: getStdIDKO
methods.description: Returns standard 'ko' response structure with ID=-1.

methods.name: byeHTTP500
methods.description: Outputs a 500 HTTP error response with a message.

methods.name: msgFromException
methods.description: Generates a string message from an exception object.
